home.intro: Online party games about academic life, played in the browser. Everyone joins the same room from their own phone or laptop: pick a nickname and you're in, with no sign-up.

keywords.name: Double Blind
keywords.summary: Two research groups race to find their keywords from one-word clues. Reveal Reviewer 2, and your paper is rejected.

impostor.name: Spot the Impostor
impostor.summary: Everyone gets the same term except one, who gets a close cousin.

titles.name: Real or Fake
titles.summary: Tell real paper titles from invented ones.

abstracts.name: Bluff the Abstract
abstracts.summary: Write a convincing abstract for a paper nobody has read.

rules.title: How to play
rules.goal: Two research groups, red and blue, each have keywords hidden among the 25 cards on the board. The group that finds all of its keywords first wins.
rules.roles: Each group has one PI and as many students as it likes. The PIs see which cards belong to whom; the students see only the words.

turn.free: The PI gives a clue and a number: how many cards the clue points to, from 1 to the cards the group has left. The students then reveal cards one at a time, and go on for as long as they find their group's cards. Once they have revealed a card, they may end the turn.
turn.standard: The PI gives a clue and a number: how many cards the clue points to. The students then reveal cards one at a time, up to that number plus one. With 0 or ∞ there is no limit. Once they have revealed a card, they may end the turn.

rules.reveal: One of your group's cards: go on. An irrelevant paper or a card of the other group: your turn ends, and the other group's card counts for them. Reviewer 2: your paper is rejected, and your group loses at once.

clue.zh: A clue is one word, with at most one Chinese character. | A clue is one word, with at most {count} Chinese characters.
clue.en: A clue is one word. | A clue has at most {count} words.

rules.clueCommon: It can't be a word on the board, a part of one, or the card's term in the other language. The PI says nothing else and makes no gestures.

clueRule.strict: This room's clue check is strict: a clue can't be another form of a word on the board that the word lists give, or have a Chinese character in common with one. Other forms, which the check can only guess at, bring a warning, and the PI decides.
clueRule.loose: This room's clue check is loose: other forms of a word on the board, and Chinese characters in common with one, only bring a warning, and the PI decides.

rules.time: Each phase has a time limit, and the bar under the turn shows what is left. A PI who gives no clue in time loses the turn to the other group. Students whose time runs out end their turn, even if they have revealed nothing.
rules.noTime: This room has no time limits.
rules.end: A group wins as soon as all its cards are revealed, even when the other group revealed the last one.
